teach.zh: 坠：爹背上那只包，拖着他往下——背带也划得断。
teach.en: Dead weight: the pack on Father's back drags him down — its strap can be cut.

name.zh: 银色的血 · 八道断口
银色的血 · 八道断口

how.zh: 哪道断口渗血了，就拿手按住哪道；不渗的按不住。那道不渗了，手自己回来。
how.en: Press a hand on whichever stump starts to bleed — only one that bleeds. When it stops, the hand comes back by itself.

zh.ready: 柴垛上没人，只有月亮。它一整天都没醒，尾根上那八道断口，又渗出血来——银色的。
zh.go: 哪道断口渗血了，就按住哪道。
zh.wasted: 这道没渗——手白挪了一下。
zh.poured: 那道不渗了。手抬起来，又护回它身上。
zh.dry: 半夜里，血不渗了。柴草上干干的，它还睡着。
zh.wet: 半夜里，血不渗了。柴草上落了几点银的。
zh.short: 半夜里，血不渗了。柴草上银晃晃的一片。
zh.flood: 银的一滴一滴落在柴草上，像下了一层霜。他把它往膝盖上拢一拢，拿身子挡着风，再按。

en.ready: Nobody on the woodpile, only the moon. It hasn't woken all day, and the eight stumps at the root of its tail are oozing again — silver.
en.wasted: Not bleeding here — a wasted reach.
en.poured: That one has stopped. His hand comes back to cover it.
en.spill: *Drip.* A silver drop on the brushwood.
en.dry: Past midnight the bleeding stops. The brushwood is dry, and it sleeps on.
en.wet: Past midnight the bleeding stops. A few silver drops on the brushwood.
en.short: Past midnight the bleeding stops. The brushwood glints silver.
en.flood: Drop by drop the silver falls on the brushwood, like frost. He gathers it onto his knees, shields it from the wind, and presses again.

name.zh: 捡球递水 · 五十七分钟
捡球递水 · 五十七分钟

how.zh: 场边哪儿要球、要水，就点哪儿跑过去；没人要的地方，白跑。
how.en: Wherever someone wants a ball or a bottle, tap it and run there; where nobody wants one, it's a wasted run.

zh.ready: 看台上坐了小一百号人。他坐在白队板凳的最末，球衣没湿。
zh.go: 哪儿要球、要水，就往哪儿跑。
zh.poured: 那头够了。他又回到板凳最末。
zh.dry: 终场哨响。五十七分钟，球一个没落下，水一瓶没耽误。
zh.wet: 终场哨响。场边滚了好几个球，他的掌心都拍红了。
zh.short: 终场哨响。场边乱糟糟的，球滚得到处都是。
zh.flood: 雷老师吼：「0号！球呢？水呢？」他从头坐回板凳最末。

en.ready: Nearly a hundred in the stands. He sits at the very end of the White bench, his jersey dry.
en.go: Wherever they want a ball or water, run there.
en.wasted: Nobody wants one here — a wasted run.
en.poured: That end's sorted. Back to the end of the bench.
en.spill: A ball rolls over the line; nobody fetches it.
en.thick: Two ends want him at once.
en.dry: Final whistle. Fifty-seven minutes, not a ball left lying, not a bottle late.
en.wet: Final whistle. A few balls rolled loose at the side; his palms are red from clapping.
en.short: Final whistle. The sideline's a mess, balls everywhere.
en.flood: Coach Lei roars: "Number 0! Ball? Water?" Back to the end of the bench, from the start.

name.en: Not the third stone · The tipping slab
Not the third stone · The tipping slab

how.zh: 谁的脚要落到第三块石板上，就点哪儿喊住他；没人要踩的地方，白喊。
how.en: Wherever someone is about to tread on the third flagstone, tap there and call him back; where nobody is, it's a wasted shout.

spots.en: The top of the stone step

zh.ready: 她照着肚子里那张图走。人挤着人，一窝一窝往石室里涌。
zh.go: 谁的脚要落到第三块上，就喊谁。
zh.placed: 「别踩第三块！」他把脚缩了回去。
zh.poured: 人过去了。她给人群推着往前走。
zh.spill: 坑里「哎哟」一声，又掉下去一个。
zh.dry: 人都过去了。第三块石板，一个人也没踩着。
zh.wet: 人都过去了。坑里还有人在喊。
zh.short: 人都过去了。坑里「哎哟」声一片。
zh.flood: 人群把她推出了石室。她回头再喊——从头来。

en.ready: She goes by the map in her head. People shove against people, pouring into the chambers knot by knot.
en.go: Whoever is about to set foot on the third stone, call to him.
en.placed: "Don't step on the third one!" He pulls his foot back.
en.poured: They're past. The crowd pushes her on.
en.spill: An "Ow!" from the pit: another one down.
en.dry: They're all past. Not one foot on the third stone.
en.wet: They're all past. Someone is still calling from the pit.
en.short: They're all past. The pit is full of "Ow!"
en.flood: The crowd shoves her out of the chamber. She turns back to call again, from the start.

how.zh: 他的脚后跟落到哪道汪着水的石缝上，就往哪儿撒一粒谷；干的石缝，撒了也不长。
how.en: Wherever his heel comes down on a crack still pooled with water, throw a grain there; in a dry crack it won't grow.

zh.ready: 墙缝那头的黑里，有人轻轻「嘘」了一声，轻得像风。
zh.go: 他踩到哪道湿缝，谷就往哪儿撒。
zh.placed: 「噼噼啪啪」——一根青藤缠上了他的脚踝。
zh.wasted: 那道缝是干的——谷粒蹦了一蹦，没长。
zh.poured: 藤给他「啪」地挣断了。石缝里又汪着水。
zh.spill: 他一步迈了过去，盾沿往前一顶。
zh.dry: 一腿的藤，一根挨一根，把他往后一拽。
zh.wet: 藤断了又长，长了又断，他到底挪不开脚。
zh.short: 藤缠住了一半，他还在挣。
zh.flood: 他甩开了藤，一步一步往墙缝那头走——谷子，再撒一回。

en.ready: In the dark beyond the crack in the wall, someone went "Shh," soft as a breath of wind.
en.go: Whichever wet crack he treads on, throw the grain there.
en.placed: *Pip-pip-pop*: a green vine wraps his ankle.
en.wasted: That crack is dry: the grain hops and doesn't grow.
en.poured: He snaps the vine. The crack pools with water again.
en.spill: He steps clear, the shield's rim pushing on.
en.dry: A legful of vines, one after another, hauling him back.
en.wet: The vines snap and grow, grow and snap; he can't get his feet free.
en.short: Half bound, he is still straining.
en.flood: He shakes off the vines and walks step by step toward the crack. Throw the grain again.

games._levels: 喂饼's levels, here once (2026-10-16): the beat gets them through Look (the task's deal, look.mjs), mount() alone reads them here. World 360×440: the 饼 at `bread` hung from `vines` (anchor `at`, optional `slack`), the fox's mouth at `mouth` (`fox_flip`: facing left), `stones` (x, y, w, h, a degrees), a `gust` puff at `at` blowing `to`, an optional `piece` (a 饼角, a star), `say` the hint. Each is solved by order alone; games/bots/bread.js holds the answers.

say.zh: 饼挂在藤上。划断它。
say.en: The bread hangs from a vine. Cut it.

say.zh: 两根藤。先断哪一根？
say.en: Two vines. Which one first?

say.zh: 石板斜着。饼角在高的那头。
say.en: The slab slopes. The corner is at its high end.

say.zh: 洞口有风。点一下那团风。
say.en: Wind at the cave mouth. Tap the puff.

games._levels: Re-laid 2026-10-20 (the live hand won the 10-16 level in 5–12 s with one low swipe: both vines cut at once, the meat on the slab, one puff). Now the slab is a chute off to the side, and the meat must be swung onto it: cut the other vine first, the meat swings out on the crow's vine, then cut the crow's vine before the crow gets down (2.8 s) — any time after the swing has started (0.6 s) puts it on the chute, into the pan. A low swipe that cuts both drops the meat straight to the floor; the crow's vine first leaves it hanging over the floor on the other; waiting, the crow takes it. ★3: cut as the swing reaches its far end (1.05–1.5 s after the first cut), through the 灵光 up there. No puff. Found by a scratch search on rope.js and proved by bots/rentrope.js (plain and star plans) and a node imitation of play-human's casual hand (median 37 s, 53/60 within 90 s; the 10-16 level 9 s).

teach.zh: 乌鸦顺着藤往下爬。先断另一根，让肉荡开，再赶在它前头断它那根。
teach.en: A crow is walking down a vine. Cut the other one first so the meat swings out, then cut the crow's before it gets there.

games._levels: 忍字 (2026-10-21, Hanli, 第一回's lineup: 「按你的建议来」 — six boards, four kits): 00-masan, 马小宝's 桂花糕 under 小满's nose — 「那股香味从他鼻孔里钻进去，顺着喉咙往下滑，一路滑到他空了一整天的肚子里」 — and the breath held down: 忍 as holding the breath. The kit's first level (n 1, before 吹鹅毛): one gentle 乱流 pushing up (the anger, the hunger), the channel sinking to the belly, 气海 the 穴, a short 金线 at the end. Was 割绳子 `tauntrope` (10-20).

book.zh: 「那股香味从他鼻孔里钻进去，顺着喉咙往下滑，一路滑到他空了一整天的肚子里。」
book.en: "The smell crept in at his nostrils, slid down his throat, slid all the way down into a stomach that had been empty all day."

say.zh: 糕举到鼻子底下了。按住是吸，松开是吐——那口气往上冲，就松开，把它压回肚子里。
say.en: The cake is under your nose. Hold to breathe in, let go to breathe out: when the breath surges up, let go and press it back down.

end.zh: 他没敢出声，在心里骂得极响：你爷爷的。
end.en: He didn't dare say it out loud, but in his heart he swore it as loud as he could: Your grandpa's—

games._levels: 气走经脉 (games/qimai.js, Hanli 10-19): the breath kit — hold to rise (吸), let go to sink (吐), a 气 bead along a meridian channel; one level a row, played in the 游戏厅 beside the breath game it may one day replace (story wiring waits for his play). The ladder (difficulty, games/bots/qimai.js proves each) is each level's `n` (not where its row sits): feather · xisui · (since 2026-10-20) tiaoshui · shuitong · paobu · qianmi · faqiu · zhoutian · …, then the arcade-only chongmai · daimai · dazhoutian. A level (World 360×220, the bead at x 96; units/s): `speed`, `len`, `path` [[x, y]] the channel's middle, `width` [[x, half-width]] (≤ 36 is 窄脉), `gates` [{x, gap, y?, name}] 关窍, `xue` [{x, name}] 穴 checkpoints, `currents` [{from, to, push}] 乱流 (+ down), `waves` [{from, to, push}] 浪头, `heart` [{from, to, beat, kick}] 心跳乱流, `gold` [{from, to, amp, period, rise}] 金线 (rise 0.4: 吸四吐六), `dark` [{from, to, r}] 暗; `say` (the opening line), `book` (the book's line while it plays), `end`. `data.level` names the row's level for mount().

book.zh: 「蹲獐子的时候，别憋着气。气往脚底下沉。」
book.en: "When you're lying in wait for a river deer, don't hold your breath. Let it sink down to your feet."

say.zh: 按住是吸，松开是吐。别憋——吐得细，吐得长，比一根头发还细。
say.en: Hold to breathe in, let go to breathe out. Don't hold it — breathe out thin and long, thinner than a hair.

end.zh: 那团光在他胸口停了好一会儿。镜子是灰的，什么也没亮。
end.en: The light rested on his chest a long while. The mirror was grey; nothing lit.

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 水桶落井
name.en: Qi path · The bucket goes down

games._levels: The reading cap before 入门, the third beat (Hanli 10-20: 「可以, 把水桶那关也加上」): 00-notice's night on the woodpile — 「心口底下那只卡了一夏天的水桶，忽然「咯噔」一声，自己往下走了：那一缕热沉过心口，沉到肚脐，稳稳地落住了」. The channel sinks from the chest to the navel: the breath 「往上一顶」 is a 乱流 pushing up, 心口 the 关 where the bucket was stuck all summer, one 浪头 below it (马三's lantern passing), the 金线 where it settles; 膻中 and 中脘 the 穴. n 4, between 挑水 and 边跑边念. Live-fitted hand (60 runs): 60/60, 2.0 岔气, 38 s — 挑水 1.8, 边跑边念 2.7; sloppy (30) 24/30, 6.9 岔气 — 挑水 22/30, 5.9.

book.zh: 「心口底下那只卡了一夏天的水桶，忽然「咯噔」一声，自己往下走了。」
book.en: "The bucket under his heart that had been stuck all summer suddenly went clunk and moved down by itself."

say.zh: 别憋，也别数。那口气往上一顶，就松开，细细地吐；过了心口，让它自己沉到肚脐。
say.en: Don't hold it, don't count. When the breath pushes up, let go and breathe out thin; past the heart, let it sink to the navel by itself.

end.zh: 那一缕热沉过心口，沉到肚脐，稳稳地落住了。
end.en: That thread of warmth sank past his heart, sank to his navel, and settled there, steady.

why.zh: 第一回改成六关：忍字改成气走经脉（忍，就是把那口气压下去）
why.en: Chapter 1 cut to six boards: 忍字 is a breath level now (holding the breath down)

teach.zh: 弹竹：落上去，弹得比来时还高。糕停在石板上了？点那团风。
teach.en: Springy bamboo: whatever lands on it bounces higher than it came. Cake stuck on the slab? Tap the puff.

why.zh: 第一回改成六关：认路撤下，书里整段讲完
why.en: Chapter 1 cut to six boards: the passage tells it whole

teach.zh: 灵气泡：碰到它就飘起来，点一下泡就破。
teach.en: A qi bubble: what touches it floats up. Tap it to pop.

book.zh: 「今夜就泡。疼，别喊。」浪头上别松口。
book.en: "Tonight you soak. It hurts. Don't cry out." On the wave, don't let go.

say.zh: 疼是一阵一阵的。浪头压下来，就一直吸着，别松。
say.en: The pain comes in waves. When one comes down, keep breathing in; don't let go.

end.zh: 一盆水从墨绿变成了漆黑。
end.en: The water went from green to black.

book.zh: 「追兔子比快，追鹿比稳；上山的路，是山的，你跟山抢，山不让你。」
book.en: "Chase a hare for speed, a deer for steadiness; the way up a mountain belongs to the mountain, and if you race it, it won't let you through."

say.zh: 三步一吸，三步一呼。石阶一级比一级高——吸的时候气往下沉，呼的时候脚往前送。
say.en: Three steps in, three steps out. Each step higher than the last — breathing in, sink the breath; breathing out, send the foot forward.

end.zh: 炉里最后一截香灰，恰在他那只脚落地的时候，断了。
end.en: The last of the ash in the burner broke off just as his foot came down.

book.zh: 肋骨疼，一口气吸不到底，他就不吸到底
book.en: His ribs hurt and he couldn't draw a breath all the way down, so he didn't draw it all the way down

say.zh: 吸不到底，就不吸到底：肚子一鼓，一落，浅浅的，落得长长的。肋骨一抽，别慌。
say.en: If the breath won't go all the way down, don't take it all the way: belly up, belly down, shallow, the fall drawn long. When the rib catches, don't panic.

end.zh: 近旁几株灵草的叶子，都朝他这边歪过来。
end.en: The leaves of the herbs nearest him all leaned his way.

book.zh: 不躲，也不压，由它探。
book.en: He didn't dodge it and he didn't press it down; he let it probe.

say.zh: 褚先生那股凉丝丝的灵力顺着经脉往里探，碰到哪里，哪里便像给铁刷子刷了一下。不躲，不压，稳住那一线；碰着肋骨那一下，别乱。
say.en: Master Chu's cool thread of power probes along the meridians, and wherever it touches feels dragged by an iron brush. Don't dodge, don't press: hold the line; when it reaches the rib, don't flinch.

end.zh: 褚先生松了手，眉头一皱：「二层。」
end.en: Master Chu let go and frowned. "Second layer."

book.zh: 吸气，肚子鼓起来，绷住，往上推
book.en: breathed in, his belly swelled, he braced, and pushed

say.zh: 杠放下来，吸气，绷住；往上推的时候，「呵——」从牙缝里一点一点吐出去。别憋。五个。
say.en: Bar down, breathe in, brace; as you push, let it out through your teeth, bit by bit. Don't hold it. Five.

end.zh: 三十公斤，他连着推了五个。
end.en: Thirty kilos, and he had pushed five in a row.

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 吸四吐六
name.en: Qi path · In four, out six

book.zh: 他吸气，数四拍；吐气，数六拍
book.en: He breathed in, counting four; breathed out, counting six

say.zh: 侧过身子，蹲下，眼睛看地。吸，数四拍；吐，数六拍——吐得长长的。那狗喉咙里的声音，会停的。
say.en: Turn side-on, crouch, eyes on the ground. In for four; out for six, long. The sound in the dog's throat will stop.

end.zh: 心口那阵乱跳慢了下来；那狗喉咙里的声音，也停了。
end.en: The jumping in his chest slowed down, and the sound in the dog's throat stopped too.

title.zh: 隐身符 · 比草叶还轻
title.en: The concealing talisman · Lighter than a blade of grass

book.zh: 一口气喘得比草叶还轻
book.en: breathing lighter than a blade of grass

say.zh: 隐身符贴在心口，人连影子也没了；可九层的神识贴着地扫过来——气要细，要匀，扫过石缝那一下，一丝也别乱。
say.en: The concealing talisman on her heart, she is gone, shadow and all; but a ninth-layer's spirit sense sweeps along the ground. Breathe thin and even; as it passes the crack, not a flicker.

end.zh: 那一凉滑过石缝，没有停。
end.en: The chill slid over the crack and didn't stop.

book.en: "Hide."

say.zh: 石头肚里的光一层一层透上来。别慌——气吐细，吐长，一丝也别往外冒。
say.en: The light seeps up from inside the stone, layer by layer. Don't panic — breathe out thin and long; not one thread of it showing.

end.zh: 测灵石亮了——亮得很暗。
end.en: The stone lit — very dimly.

book.en: The qi climbs the du channel: Weilü, Jiaji, Yuzhen. The last half of Yuzhen was left for him.

book.en: "Push them round once." So he pushed. A force that pushed upwards rose from the dantian: wood, fire, earth, metal, water, round once.

say.zh: 从丹田起，推着它走一圈：木往上拱，火一跳一跳，土最沉，金细得像一根弦，水凉，会拐。
say.en: From the dantian, push it round once: wood heaves up, fire leaps, earth is the heaviest, metal thin as a bowstring, water cold, and it turns.

end.zh: 五扇门敞开着，底下长出了一块厚地。
end.en: The five doors stood open, and under them a patch of deep ground had grown.

book.zh: 「它听见的不是你喘，是你心慌。」镜光扫过来，吐气要长要慢。
book.en: "It doesn't hear you breathe; it hears you panic." The light sweeps over — breathe out long and slow.

say.zh: 大通铺里，镜光一铺一铺照过来。气要藏得细——脉窄，一路窄到底。
say.en: In the long dormitory the light comes bunk by bunk. Keep the breath thin — the channel narrow all the way.

end.zh: 镜光过去了，牌子是凉的。
end.en: The light has passed; the token is cold.

how.zh: 右手抓一根荆条，抓牢了；脚下踩稳那一下，把身子「送」上去，再去抓上面一根。
how.en: Grab a bramble with your right hand and hold it; when your foot finds the hold, push yourself up, then reach for the next.

ready.zh: 左手腕肿着，使不上力。崖腰往上，便是昨儿他爹膝盖罢工的那道坡。肩上那团毛，凉凉的。
ready.en: His left wrist is swollen and useless. Above the cliff's waist is the slope where his father's knee gave out yesterday. The ball of fur on his shoulder is cold.

clean.zh: 他坐上那块凸出来的石头喘气。肩上那团毛，爪子松了一分。
clean.en: He sits on the jutting stone to catch his breath. The claws on his shoulder ease a little.

clumsy.zh: 爬到一半，他坐上那块凸出来的石头喘气，手心全是荆刺。

skipped.zh: 他一根一根抓着荆条，爬到了崖腰。
skipped.en: One bramble at a time, he reaches the waist of the cliff.

ready.en: "These are skinfold calipers. A pinch tells how thick the skin is: body fat."

clean.en: All three pinched and he never shook once. Ahe notes it down.

clumsy.zh: 阿禾道：「再抖，就从头量。」总算量完了。

skipped.zh: 阿禾捏完了，在本子上记了一笔。

how.en: Four bearers block the steps. Watch their legs: as they stride apart, crawl through, under the poles.

ready.en: His father had said: what blocks your way, you don't have to climb over.

clean.en: He crawled under the litter without touching a thing.

skipped.zh: 他从轿夫的腿缝里钻了过去。

how.en: Hold "Draw" to coax the warmth into your arm and let go when it's full; three times, and it reaches your fist. When it's hot, punch.

ready.en: At the top of the cliff stood a big bluestone, a head taller than he was, its face covered in moss.

clean.en: Crack: a slab of skin breaks off the bluestone, moss and all. His fist isn't even scraped.

hold.en: Coax the warmth circling inside you out along your arm, bit by bit.

short.zh: 暖才动了一动，又缩回去了。
short.en: The warmth stirs, and shrinks back.

done.en: It creeps lazily up his arm, into his fist.

guard.zh: 拳头攥着，等它热透。
guard.en: Fist clenched, he waits for it to heat through.

hit.zh: 那股暖从拳头上漏走了，又退回胳膊里。
hit.en: The warmth leaks out of his fist, back into his arm.

early.en: Not hot yet.

how.en: When it stares your way, drop your breath and press the tightness down; then stand up slowly, take three steps and set the radish down gently.

ready.zh: 丑时过了一半。紫玉参旁边，那东西抱着灵草啃，「咔、咔」。他手里只有一根萝卜。
ready.en: Halfway through the hour of the Ox. By the purple jade ginseng the thing gnaws a spirit herb: tock, tock. All he has in his hand is a radish.

clean.zh: 萝卜搁在它面前的地上。它没跑。
clean.en: The radish lies on the ground in front of it. It doesn't run.

clumsy.zh: 它往后缩了一缩，到底没跑。萝卜搁在它面前。
clumsy.en: It shrinks back a little, but doesn't run. The radish lies in front of it.

skipped.en: He sets the radish down in front of it and steps back.

guard.en: It paws at the herbs, its nose twitching.

tell.en: It's staring this way — all five tails up!

hit.zh: 心口一紧，它「咔」地往后一跳。
hit.en: His chest tightens; it leaps back, tock.

early.en: It hasn't looked yet. Keep still.

done.zh: 肚子一落，落得长长的，那一紧按下去了。
done.en: His belly drops, a long drop, and the tightness is pressed down.

hold.en: Stand up slowly, both hands open.

short.en: Up too fast: it crouches low.

over.zh: 磨蹭太久，它又要往崖根底下钻了。
over.en: Too slow: it's about to bolt for the cliff's foot.

done.zh: 站起来了。它没跑，眼睛盯着他的手。
done.en: He's up. It doesn't run; its eyes are on his hands.

hold.en: Three steps, bend down, set the radish down gently.

short.zh: 放得太急，萝卜「咚」地滚了半圈。
short.en: Too quick: the radish thumps and rolls half a turn.

over.zh: 弯着腰半天不起来，它又往后缩了缩。
over.en: Bent over too long; it shrinks back again.

how.en: Run to the beeps: when it beeps and your foot is on the line, turn. Each beep comes quicker.

ready.zh: 十月十七日，早上八点，体育馆一楼。来试训的二十三个人站成三排。
ready.en: The seventeenth of October, eight in the morning, the sports hall. Twenty-three for the trials, in three rows.

clean.zh: 嘀声越来越急，一个一个的人退了下去，他还在跑。吐，吸，吐。
clean.en: The beeps come faster, people drop out one by one, and he's still running. Out, in, out.

clumsy.zh: 嗓子眼里又烧起来了。他没往嗓子眼里抢气，往外吐，又撑了几个来回。
clumsy.en: His throat burns again. He doesn't snatch at the air; he breathes out, and holds on a few lengths more.

skipped.zh: 他跟着嘀声来回跑，撑到了后头。
skipped.en: He runs to the beeps, and holds on till near the end.

guard.zh: 往那头跑。
guard.en: Run to the far line.

hit.en: Half a step late: the beep has gone.

guard.en: The beeps come a little quicker.

guard.zh: 「不行就下来，别吐在地板上！」
guard.en: "If you can't hack it, come off, don't throw up on the floor!"

guard.zh: 两条腿又不听使唤了。
guard.en: His legs stop obeying him again.

how.zh: 脚踩实了，就「挪」；右手按住「抠」，抠稳就松；底下火光一亮，立刻「贴」平。
how.en: When your foot is firm, lower yourself; hold "Grip" and let go once it's steady; when the firelight flares below, flatten yourself at once.

ready.zh: 这道崖从上到下一根草也不长，石头凉得透骨。左边的肋骨，到这时候还没长牢。
ready.en: Not a blade of grass on this cliff from top to bottom, the rock cold to the bone. His left ribs still haven't knitted.

clean.zh: 火光底下，他塞在石缝里，贴得像崖上的一道影子。
clean.en: Under the firelight he is wedged in the crack, flat as a shadow on the cliff.

clumsy.zh: 他贴进石缝里，碎石子还在往下掉，所幸底下没人抬头。
clumsy.en: He presses into the crack with grit still falling; luckily nobody below looks up.

skipped.zh: 他顺着崖壁往下爬，爬到一半，贴进了一道石缝。
skipped.en: He climbs down the cliff face and, halfway, presses into a crack.

guard.zh: 脚尖在崖壁上摸下一个落脚的地方。
guard.en: His toe feels down the rock for the next hold.

hit.zh: 脚底一滑，左肋一扯，他又挂回原处。
hit.en: His foot slips, his left ribs wrench, and he hangs where he was.

early.en: There's nothing under his foot yet.

hold.zh: 右手抠住上面那道石缝。
hold.en: His right hand digs into the crack above.

over.zh: 攥得太死，左肋像有人往里头塞了一根针。
over.en: Too hard — his left ribs feel a needle pushed in.

guard.en: His toe feels down the rock for the next hold.

hit.en: His foot slips, his left ribs wrench, and he hangs where he was.

guard.zh: 底下黑洞洞的，只听得见水滴的声音。
guard.en: Black below; only the dripping water.

hit.zh: 火折子往上一晃，他赶紧往石缝里缩。
hit.en: The fire-stick swings up and he shrinks into the crack just in time.

early.en: Nothing below yet.

done.zh: 他把身子往石缝里一塞，贴平了。
done.en: He wedges himself into the crack and lies flat.

The horse talisman · Tread it underfoot

how.zh: 看他的葫芦：一抖，火蛇扑来就「跺」；那张歪马符要先「拍」上脚底——按一下就松。
how.en: Watch his gourd: when it shakes and the snakes lunge, stamp; first slap the crooked-horse talisman on your sole — press briefly.

ready.zh: 背后是崖，崖上是阵；前头是火，脚底下三四步宽，往哪边都是死。腰带夹层里，叠着一张黄纸。
ready.en: Behind, the cliff and the array on it; in front, fire; underfoot three or four paces of ledge. Either way is death. In the lining of his belt, a folded sheet of yellow paper.

clean.zh: 他离了地，贴着地皮横着飞了出去，四条火蛇在他身后撞成一团。
clean.en: He leaves the ground and skims sideways, and the four fire snakes crash together behind him.

clumsy.zh: 火舌舔着了他的袖子；他到底离了地，横着飞了出去。
clumsy.en: A tongue of fire catches his sleeve, but he leaves the ground at last and skims away.

skipped.zh: 他把那张歪马往脚底一拍，往地上一跺。
skipped.en: He slaps the crooked horse onto his sole and stamps.

hold.zh: 把那张歪马往左脚底板上拍——足下一踏，马上便走。
hold.en: Slap the crooked horse onto your left sole: tread it underfoot and ride away at once.

short.en: Not pressed home; the corner curls up.

over.en: Pressed too hard; the paper creases.

guard.zh: 他抬起那只喷火的葫芦。
guard.en: He raises the fire-spouting gourd.

hit.zh: 火蛇擦着你的肩膀过去，燎焦了半边袄子。
hit.en: A fire snake grazes your shoulder and scorches half your jacket.

early.en: The gourd hasn't moved.

done.zh: 脚底板上一烫，像踩着了一块炭。
done.en: The sole of your foot burns, as if you'd trodden on a coal.

guard.zh: 四条火蛇，一条从左，一条从右，一条贴着地，一条绕到背后。
guard.en: Four fire snakes: one from the left, one from the right, one along the ground, one round behind.

hit.zh: 火舌舔进了袄襟。
hit.en: Fire licks into your jacket.

early.en: They're still circling.

done.zh: 他整个人离了地，离地三尺。
done.en: He leaves the ground, three feet up.

book.zh: 喘得又快又浅，一半是白喘。先吐，再吸。
book.en: Quick shallow pants are half wasted. Out first, then in.

say.zh: 跑起来了，气道一阵窄一阵宽。窄的地方，一口别吸满。
say.en: Running now; the airway narrows and opens. Where it narrows, never a full breath.

end.zh: 「沈芒，四分二十九。……过了。」
end.en: "Shen Mang, four twenty-nine. … Passed."

book.zh: 「吸是踩油门，吐是踩刹车。吐得比吸的长，心就慢一截。」
book.en: "In is the throttle, out is the brake. Out longer than in, and the heart slows."

say.zh: 心跳一百四十一。吸四吐六——贴着金线走。
say.en: Heart at a hundred and forty-one. In for four, out for six — ride the gold thread.

end.zh: 出手，进了。
end.en: He shoots. In.

book.en: "Xiaobao. Breathe with me. Out longer than in."

say.zh: 九点整，灯灭了。脉一折一折地拐，只看得见眼前一小圈——记住它往哪拐。
say.en: Nine o'clock, the lights go. The channel switches back and forth; you see only a small round — remember where it bends.

end.zh: 「……手不麻了。」
end.en: "… My hands aren't numb any more."

book.zh: 惧是油门，长吐是刹车——刹得住一截，刹不干净。带着怕投。
book.en: Fear is the throttle, a long breath out the brake: it slows, never stops. Shoot with the fear.

say.zh: 零点六秒，落后一分。看台在喊「百分之一！」心跳没有准点。
say.en: Point six seconds, one behind. The stand chants "One per cent!" The heart keeps no time.

end.zh: 它掉了进去。
end.en: It drops in.

book.zh: 冲脉直上直下，浪头和乱流挤在一条道上。
book.en: The thoroughfare runs straight up and down; waves and currents crowd one road.

say.zh: 浪头、转向的乱流、关口，一样一样来。
say.en: Waves, turning currents, passes — one after another.

end.zh: 冲脉通了。
end.en: The thoroughfare is open.

book.zh: 带脉横着绕腰一圈，黑里走，心还在跳。
book.en: The girdle runs round the waist — through the dark, with the heart still pounding.

say.zh: 窄、暗、心跳，风还掉头。别慌，吐得比吸的长。
say.en: Narrow, dark, a racing heart, a turning wind. Don't panic; out longer than in.

end.zh: 带脉绕了一圈，回到了原处。
end.en: Round the girdle, and back where it began.

book.zh: 小周天转熟了，气才走得了大周天——什么都会碰上。
book.en: Only once the small circuit is easy can the qi go the great one — and meet everything.

say.zh: 一口气走完全身。前面什么都有，岔了气也只回到上一关。
say.en: One breath through the whole body. Everything lies ahead; a broken breath goes back only to the last pass.

end.zh: 大周天转了一圈，浑身通透。
end.en: The great circuit turns once; the whole body clears.

撒豆成兵 — the crowd run, a 塔防-family level type, a prototype (Hanli 10-20: 「对, 做一个撒豆成兵的关卡」; the genre: crowd + math gates, Count Masters / Mob Control; the bar: 《向僵尸开炮》). Portrait, one hand: drag left/right (A/D, ←/→) steers 小满's bean soldiers up the 山道 through 符门 gates (+ × good, − ÷ traps), past hazards and bean pickups, through the 兽潮 hordes (crowds cancel out) to 合窳; stars by soldiers left. The lead-in and countdown start it by themselves. The engine: games/sadou/core.js; the play: games/sadou/sadou.min.mjs (Phaser, tools/sadou/); the level: worlds/jiuding/levels/sadou.json. Dealt in the 秘境 it sends only the beasts of the 回 he has reached (rules/reveal.mjs, Hanli 10-21: 鬿雀 from 古八): one not yet met stands aside for the latest met, worth the same; the 游戏厅 plays the ladder as made.

撒豆成兵 · 守山门 — the DEFENCE crowd game, a second 撒豆成兵 beside the attack run (`sadou`), TEST-ONLY here for comparing (Hanli 10-21, of a crowd-gate ad: 「好像比我们的撒豆成兵好玩一点」, 「好, 做一版. 这个是在防守, 现在的撒豆成兵是在进攻.」); not in the story, not in the 秘境 pool. Portrait, one hand: aim left/right and HOLD to scatter beans; each runs UP a pseudo-3D road as a 豆兵 through walls of gates (a safe lane of +1s, a 符门 in the middle, a rich +99 lane the tide runs past) and grinds the 兽潮 coming down, then the 大妖 walks down and charges down a line it shows first; the horde at the wall is the loss, stars by the wall left and the time. The engine: games/sadoushou/core.js; the play: games/sadoushou/sadoushou.min.mjs (Phaser, tools/sadoushou/); the levels: worlds/jiuding/levels/sadoushou.json (four, each a 回's beasts).

Portrait: beasts pour down the 山道 at 沉鼎观's 山门 in waves; 小满 casts from the wall, 银月 beside him; after each wave the player picks 1 of 3 cards (剑阵 · 火符 · 寒符 · 雷符 · 银月, the 守炉 kit as skills); a tap on a beast focuses it. The first wave comes on a countdown with the lead-in, never a tap. Stars from the wall left. Phaser on the shared scripts/vendor/phaser.min.mjs (tools/shouqiang/ → games/shouqiang/shouqiang.min.mjs); the engine games/shouqiang/core.js; the level, waves and cards: worlds/jiuding/levels/shouqiang.json; the bots: tests/game-shouqiang.test.mjs. Not placed in the story yet: after Hanli plays it.

施法特写, version C — a TEST for Hanli's choice, 游戏厅 only (Hanli 10-21: 「用yinyue的3D模型试一下. 另C的效果也给我看一下.」): 结印's field; a hand seen → a close-up panel slides in, 小满 in side profile (one local-FLUX painting) with his hands live ink strokes from the player's; a seal held or a push → the hand thrusts, a 火蛋 flies. Numbers: levels/texie.json. doc/games.md § 施法特写.

施法特写, the 3D version — the same test with Yinyue's VRM (the engine's /yinyue.vrm, loaded at run time, never copied: its licence allows no redistribution) as 小满's stand-in, her finger bones live from the player's. A test only: 10-14 「游戏里不需要3D模型」 stands for the game. doc/games.md § 施法特写.

name.en: Keeping the fire · At the cave mouth

how.zh: 火堆挡在洞口，野兽便不敢进来——火一矮，黑里的眼睛就往里凑。点崖根底下的枯枝，小满折来添火；点一双眼睛，他扔石头撵。守到它们散了。
how.en: A fire across the cave mouth keeps beasts out; when it burns low, the eyes in the dark creep in. Tap a dead branch at the cliff's foot and Xiaoman snaps it for the fire; tap a pair of eyes and he throws a stone. Hold till they give up.

games._about: 守炉's 第一回 story level (2026-10-21, Hanli: 第一回 adds two 塔防 boards): 00-cave, 「火堆挡在洞口，野兽便不敢进来」, before 喂饼 — the fire at the cave mouth is the 炉, eyes in the dark, 枯枝 at the cliff's foot to keep it up, 小满 alone. The level is the `shoulu` row's `shouhuo`. This row only opens it in the 游戏厅.

name.zh: 雪夜柴垛 · 冬月的夜
name.en: The woodpile on a snowy night · Winter

how.zh: 冬月夜里，野猪踩着雪从蒙山下来，奔着屋后的柴垛。点一头野猪，小满扔石头撵；点雪地，他走过去守着。守到天亮。
how.en: Winter nights, boars come down from Mount Meng through the snow, making for the woodpile behind the house. Tap a boar and Xiaoman throws a stone; tap the snow and he goes to stand guard there. Hold till dawn.

games._about: 守炉's 第二回 story level (2026-10-22, the 卷一 plan; Hanli 10-22: 「按你说的改一遍」): 00-halfyear, split after 「自己穿一件单褂。」 — the 柴垛 behind the house is the 炉, 野猪 in the snow, 小满 alone. The level is the `shoulu` row's `chaiduo`. This row only opens it in the 游戏厅.

name.zh: 泗水路 · 路上那一夜
name.en: The road to the Si · A night on the way

how.zh: 往泗水去的路上，夜里歇在路边，舅舅睡着了。野猪从黑里出来——点一头，小满扔石头撵；火一矮，点路边的枯枝去捡来添。火堆和舅舅，都别叫它们碰着。
how.en: A night by the road to the Si River; Uncle is asleep. Boars come out of the dark: tap one and Xiaoman throws a stone; when the fire sinks, tap a dead branch by the road to fetch it. Don't let them reach the fire or Uncle.

games._about: 守炉's 第三回 story level (2026-10-22, the 卷一 plan; Hanli 10-22: 「按你说的改一遍」): 00-gate, split after the road — a night camp on the way to 泗水, the fire to feed and 舅舅 asleep by it to keep. The level is the `shoulu` row's `sishui`. This row only opens it in the 游戏厅.

name.en: Guard the Furnace · The herb garden at night

games._about: 守炉's first story level (Hanli 10-20: 「可以」 — 守炉 is the main game, a new level a 回 from 古四 on): wm-yaoyuan's second night, cut at 「天地再大，他只认得脸上的风。」; the board is the dark before the 狰 shows. The level is the `shoulu` row's `yaoyuan-xunye` (story: wm-yaoyuan): the 药园's spiral road from the west cliff's foot, 野猪 only (the 狰 is the book's to tame with a 萝卜, after it, never fought), 剑阵 · 火符, four waves. This row only opens it in the 游戏厅.

name.en: Guard the Furnace · Watching the pill furnace

games._about: 守炉's 古八 story level (Hanli 10-20: a new level a 回 from 古四 on, at its climax; 2026-10-21, the 古八 pass): 09-dabi, after the 九节聚气 night — 闵丹师 has lit the 正炉 and cannot step from it (story DESIGN § 炼丹的火: 一开炉十天半月，丹师一步离不得), the 看炉 is 小满's; the herbs' smell draws the 后山's 鬿雀 down (古八's beast, game-only like 兽潮). The 后山 · 丹房 map, 野猪 then 鬿雀, 剑阵 · 火符 · 雷符 (雷 from the third wave). This row only opens it in the 游戏厅.

守炉 — tower defense, the 游戏厅's main game (Hanli 10-20: 「塔防这个好玩, 可以作为主力游戏」, 「不用artifact, 直接放到游戏大厅里」, 「多加几关」). 小满 lays talismans (剑阵 · 火符 · 寒符 · 雷符) by the road; 银月 is the hero (tap her, then a place: she holds two ground beasts, bites, howls to stun). Waves come on a countdown, never by a tap (calling one early pays 灵石). The engine and its tuning: games/shoulu/core.js; the painting: games/shoulu/draw.js; the balance sim: tests/game-shoulu.test.mjs. `lv=<1…5>` opens one level straight away; without it, the level select (stars kept in this browser, `lingjing.shoulu.stars`, never the save). Code-drawn art is a stopgap: small games go comic.
games._levels: One row a level, in the order they climb; each brings exactly one new thing (`new`: the beast, and the talisman that answers it). `story`: null for the 游戏厅's own levels (the ladder: the select, `lv=<n>`, 下一关); a story level names its scene — one a 回 from 古四 on, at its climax, each harder than the last story level (Hanli 10-20), only beasts the book has met by then, tuned for a first-time player; it stands after the ladder in this list, off the ladder, and opens by its id (the story task's `deal.lv`, the 游戏厅's `lv=<id>`); no `new`. `place`: the places/ id it stands in. `towers`: the talismans it allows; `unlock`: {tower: wave} — one opens only from that wave. `money`: 灵石 at the start. `hpMul`: every beast's hp × this (the level's toughness; each wave also adds 12%). `difficulty` (default 1): the knob — beasts' hp and each group's count × the level's `difficulty` × this row's `difficulty` (a boss stays one); tuned at 1 for a human-like player (core.js `human`: a sensible plan, 1–2 s late, 银月 moved now and then), not the perfect bots, since no open-source game's players have proven this balance (Hanli 10-20). `lead`: the lead-in lines, shown while the first countdown runs (`big`: the 兽潮来袭 banner). `road`: the beasts' road, [x, y] on a 600×760 board, from off the edge to the furnace; `furnace`: [x, y]; `air`: where fliers start (they fly straight at the furnace). `spots`: the build spots (40–95 off the road). `hero`: 银月 — `at`, her post [x, y]; `hair`, the 狐毛 charges the story has given her (古五 on; 0 in the 游戏厅 levels but the last). `waves`: one list a wave of [beast, count, gap s, delay s].

lead.zh: 秋收后，石坳村家家烙饼。
lead.en: After the harvest, every house in Shi'ao bakes flatbread.

lead.zh: 饼香飘上蒙山，野猪下山了。
lead.en: The smell drifts up Mount Meng. The boars come down.

lead.zh: 爹还在山里，灶火交给小满。
lead.en: Father is still in the hills. The hearth is Xiaoman's.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 成群的，火符一烧一片。
lead.en: A herd? One fire talisman burns the lot.

lead.zh: 银月：野猪而已，山道交给我。
lead.en: Yinyue: Only boars. Leave the road to me.

name.en: The path up · the incense burner

lead.zh: 上山路，沟深草密。
lead.en: The path up: deep gullies, thick grass.

lead.zh: 草里窜出一团红毛——狰！
lead.en: A ball of red fur shoots out of the grass: a zheng!

lead.zh: 它太快，银月拦不住，火符也难沾身。
lead.en: Too quick for Yinyue to hold, too quick for fire to catch.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 寒符冻住它，火才落得上。
lead.en: Frost holds it still; then the fire lands.

name.en: The herb garden · the herb stove

lead.zh: 夜里，药园里「咔嚓、咔嚓」。
lead.en: At night, in the herb garden: crunch, crunch.

lead.zh: 犰狳来啃灵草了。见人则眠，一身硬甲。
lead.en: Qiuyu at the spirit herbs. They play dead, and their hides are hard.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 剑阵砍不进，火符烧得透。
lead.en: Swords glance off. Fire gets through.

name.en: The back hill · the furnace room

lead.zh: 后山崖顶，白头的鸟一群群飞起来。
lead.en: Off the back-hill cliff, white-headed birds rise in flocks.

lead.zh: 鬿雀：鼠足虎爪，不走山道，直扑丹炉。
lead.en: Qique: rat's feet, tiger's claws. They skip the road and dive at the furnace.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 火符够不着天上。剑阵够得着；第三波起，雷符也够得着。
lead.en: Fire can't reach the sky. Swords can; from the third wave, thunder too.

name.en: Black Pine Ridge · the ninefold pill

lead.zh: 黑松岭，路会自己打结。
lead.en: On Black Pine Ridge the road ties itself in knots.

lead.zh: 九转丹在炉里，还差四十九息。
lead.en: The ninefold pill is in the furnace. Forty-nine breaths to go.

lead.zh: 林子深处，有娃娃在哭——
lead.en: Deep in the pines, a baby is crying—

lead.zh: 合窳：人面，猪身，赤尾如火。
lead.en: A heyu: a man's face, a pig's body, a tail red as fire.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 它一哭，护体灵光便薄一层：那时打！
lead.en: When it wails, its shield of light thins: strike then!

name.en: Keeping the fire · At the cave mouth

levels._story: 守火 (2026-10-21, Hanli: 第一回 adds two 塔防 boards — 「用塔防作为主力」): 00-cave, 「火堆挡在洞口，野兽便不敢进来」, before 喂饼 (the 卷一 plan's order). The fire at the cave mouth is the 炉 (`fire`: its fuel is the 炉火, burning down one every `burn` s; `sticks` are the 枯枝 at the cliff's foot, back `regrow` s after one is taken; 小满 carries `carry` at most and each feeds `feed`; the light reaches `light[0]` + `light[1]` × the fire, and what shies from it (`shy`) loses `fear` × fire/max of its nerve a second inside it, slowed; `fox`: where she lies; `stars`: fire left for ★★★ · ★★). No talismans (`towers: []`, no spots); the hero is 小满 (`hero.who`), no 银月 skills (`skills: false` — she is hurt and only a fox), a 柴刀 and stones (`throw`). The beasts are eyes in the dark (`yanjing`, game-only: the book names none — 「野兽便不敢进来」). Gentle: the second 塔防 a player meets.

lead.zh: 他生了一小堆火，火堆挡在洞口，野兽便不敢进来。
lead.en: He got a little fire going. With a fire across the mouth of the cave, animals wouldn't dare come in.

lead.zh: 它躺在火边，一动不动。
lead.en: The fox lies by the fire, not moving.

lead.zh: 黑里，有眼睛！
lead.en: Eyes, in the dark!

lead.zh: 火一矮，它们就往里凑。点崖根底下的枯枝，去折来添火。
lead.en: When the fire burns low they creep in. Tap a dead branch at the cliff's foot to fetch it.

lead.zh: 点一双眼睛，扔石头撵。
lead.en: Tap a pair of eyes to throw a stone.

hint.zh: 点枯枝去添火，点眼睛扔石头
hint.en: Tap a branch to fetch it, a pair of eyes to throw a stone

lowFire.en: The fire is dying! Fetch a branch.

name.zh: 雪夜柴垛 · 冬月的夜
name.en: The woodpile on a snowy night · Winter

levels._story: 雪夜柴垛 (2026-10-21, the 卷一 small-game plan, doc/games-plan-juan1.md; Hanli: 「start building」): 00-halfyear, split after 「夜里坐在柴垛上，手脚也不冷了……自己穿一件单褂。」 — the fourth 塔防 on the ladder. A winter night behind the house: the 炉 is the 柴垛 with the 鸡窝 at its foot (`furnaceArt`; 「落进了柴垛底下的鸡窝」 — and the 竹简 is hidden at its bottom), 野猪 down from 蒙山 in the snow. 小满 alone (`hero.who`), no talismans, no 银月 (she sleeps in the 木牌), stones (`throw`); every tap an order to him (core.js `direct`). Harder than 守火: boars, not eyes — they do not shy from anything — more of them, and the snow (`snow`: the flakes; his `stats.speed` the snow's drag) slows him. Stars by the 柴垛 left (`stars`: ≥6 · ≥3, as 守火's fire). Night: he sees a boar only near him (`stats.acquire` 70) and his stones reach less far (`throw.range` 130) — the player points him at each. 第二回, a touch harder than 第一回 (Hanli 10-22: 「难度可以稍微提高一点」 → 「好的」; hpMul 0.22→0.26, gap 9→8; bots, 20 seeds h0–h19 · 100 y-seeds): keen 20/20 ★★★, the plain human 20/20 (★★ mostly), a first-timer 17/20 · 77% (★ and ★★; was 20/20 · 95%), a slow one 8/20 · 44% (was 18/20), nothing done 2/20 · 9% (was 4/20). `decor` none: the painted snow holds its own.

lead.zh: 到了冬月，他挑水从四担挑到了六担，上坡不喘。
lead.en: By the eleventh month he was carrying six loads of water instead of four, and didn't pant on the slope.

lead.zh: 夜里坐在柴垛上，手脚也不冷了。
lead.en: Sitting on the woodpile at night, his hands and feet weren't cold any more.

lead.zh: 雪地里，野猪下山了！
lead.en: Boars, down the mountain through the snow!

lead.zh: 点一头野猪，扔石头撵；点雪地，走过去守着。
lead.en: Tap a boar to throw a stone; tap the snow to go and stand guard there.

lost.en: The boars brought the woodpile down

hint.zh: 点野猪扔石头，点雪地走过去
hint.en: Tap a boar to throw a stone, the snow to go there

name.zh: 泗水路 · 路上那一夜
name.en: The road to the Si · A night on the way

levels._story: 泗水路 (2026-10-21, the 卷一 small-game plan; Hanli: 「start building」): 00-gate, split after the road — 「越往南……几千户人家，赶的是同一个日子。」 — the fifth 塔防 on the ladder, the first with a party to keep. A night camp on the three days' road to 泗水: the fire is the 炉 (守火's `fire`: it burns down, 枯枝 by the road feed it; `fox: false` — 银月 sleeps in the 木牌), and 舅舅 asleep beside it (`keep`: at, hp, r, art — a boar passing within `lure` of him turns off the road for him one time in `chance`, and within `r` gnaws him until it falls; his hp gone, the night is lost). 野猪, which no light turns back (they are not `shy`), come down the road past him to the fire. 小满 alone with stones. Harder than 雪夜柴垛: two things to hold, and the fire to feed between. 第三回, at least as hard as 雪夜柴垛 (Hanli 10-22: 「难度可以稍微提高一点」 → 「好的」; `fire.burn` 8→6.5 as 守火's, 舅舅 420→220 hp; bots, 20 seeds h0–h19 · 100 y-seeds): keen 20/20 ★★★, the plain human 20/20 (★★–★★★), a first-timer 16/20 · 74% (★ and ★★; was 20/20 · 96%), a slow one 11/20 · 50% (was 19/20 · 97%), nothing done 0/20.

lead.zh: 九月初七，沈小满跟着舅舅，走在往泗水去的大路上。
lead.en: On the seventh day of the ninth month, Shen Xiaoman was walking with his uncle on the high road to the Si River.

lead.zh: 越往南，路上往泗水去的人越多。
lead.en: The further south they went, the more people were on the road to the Si River.

lead.zh: 夜里，路边的黑里，有野猪！
lead.en: At night, boars in the dark by the road!

lead.zh: 火一矮，去捡枯枝来添；野猪啃上舅舅，先撵那一头。
lead.en: When the fire sinks, fetch a branch; a boar at Uncle, drive that one off first.

lost.zh: 火灭了，或是舅舅给啃了
lost.en: The fire went out, or Uncle was bitten

hint.zh: 点枯枝去添火，点野猪扔石头
hint.en: Tap a branch to fetch it, a boar to throw a stone

lowFire.en: The fire is dying! Fetch a branch.

name.en: The herb garden · the night watch

lead.zh: 第二夜，药园西头没有灯。他守在崖根底下的黑里。
lead.en: The second night. No light at the herb garden's west end; he keeps watch in the dark at the foot of the cliff.

lead.zh: 崖根底下，有动静！
lead.en: Something stirs at the foot of the cliff!

lead.zh: 先拱进来的，是山上的野猪。
lead.en: The first ones in are boars off the mountain.

lead.zh: 成群的，火符一烧一片。
lead.en: A herd? One fire talisman burns the lot.

lead.zh: 木牌里，一个很困的声音：……野猪而已。灵草交给你，本王再睡会儿。
lead.en: A sleepy voice in the token: …Only boars. The herbs are yours. I'm going back to sleep.

name.en: The pill house · watching the furnace

lead.zh: 闵丹师开炉，一开十天半月，一步离不得炉口。
lead.en: Pill-master Min has lit the furnace: ten days, half a month, and he cannot step from its mouth.

lead.zh: 看炉的是你。药气顺着后山，飘上了崖顶——
lead.en: The watching is yours. The smell of the herbs drifts up the back hill to the cliff—

lead.zh: 后山有动静！
lead.en: Something stirs on the back hill!

lead.zh: 先拱下来的，是闻着药香的野猪。
lead.en: The first down are boars, after the smell.

lead.zh: 鬿雀：白头，鼠足虎爪，不走山道，直扑炉口。火符够不着天上，剑阵够得着。
lead.en: Qique: white heads, rat's feet, tiger's claws. They skip the road and dive at the furnace. Fire can't reach the sky; swords can.

lead.zh: 第三波起，雷符也够得着。
lead.en: From the third wave, thunder reaches them too.

name.en: The realm · the dry river · I

lead.zh: 暗河干了，河床里一堆火，是前人留下的。
lead.en: The river has run dry. In its bed burns a fire someone left long ago.

lead.zh: 火一灭，黑里的东西就上来了。
lead.en: Let it go out and what lives in the dark comes up.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 犰狳皮厚，剑阵砍不动——火符、寒符。
lead.en: The armadillo's hide is thick; swords barely bite. Fire, frost.

name.en: The realm · the dry river · II

lead.zh: 又是那堆火。河床那头，有个人脸的东西在哭，像个娃娃。
lead.en: The same fire. Far down the riverbed, something with a man's face is crying like a baby.

lead.zh: 合窳，人面猪身，见则天下大水。
lead.en: The heyu: a man's face on a pig's body. Where it is seen, the floods come.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

name.en: The realm · the dry river · III

lead.zh: 火还在。这回，河床里的哭声有两处。
lead.en: The fire still burns. This time the crying comes from two places in the riverbed.

lead.zh: 火小了一圈。守住它，缝里的东西才拾得着。
lead.en: The fire has shrunk a ring. Hold it, and what lies in the crack is yours.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

name.zh: 射鹿 · 先看风，后看鹿
name.en: The stag · Wind first, then the deer

name.zh: 暗河 · 葫芦一开，就有光
name.en: The dry river · Open the gourd and there's light
The lecture hall · One seal at a time

games._about: The same beat where the device has a camera (tasks/h08.json qianye-qiajue `alt`): 结印's teaching level.

name.en: Free throws · On the white line

how.zh: 空球馆里只剩他一个，站在罚球线上。往后拉，看着那串点瞄准，松手把球投出去——球要从篮筐上面落进网里才算进。六个球，进一个就过关，进得越多星越多。
how.en: The gym is empty but for him, on the free-throw line. Pull back, aim by the dotted arc, let go — the ball must drop in through the rim from above. Six balls: one in passes; more in, more stars.

book.zh: 「别蹲！站起来接着走！」
book.en: "Don't squat! Stand up and keep walking!"

say.zh: 腿软得只想坐。按住是吸，松开是吐——一阵一阵发黑的时候别慌，喘匀了再走。
say.en: Your legs want only to sit. Hold to breathe in, let go to breathe out — when the black comes in waves, don't panic; even the breath, then walk on.

end.zh: 他一步一步把那一圈走完了。
end.en: He walked the rest of that lap, step by step.

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 十二正经

book.zh: 「哪里是十二条各管各的线——是一条，绕着人跑三圈。」
book.en: "Not twelve lines each going its own way — one line, running three times round a person."

say.zh: 举着手，阴经往上走，阳经往下走。手指尖、脚趾尖上换手——跟着那条线，上去，下来，上去。
say.en: Arms up: yin runs upward, yang runs downward. They change hands at the fingertips and the toes — follow the line: up, down, up.

end.zh: 他闭上眼睛，又比了一遍，一条没错。
end.en: He shut his eyes and traced it all again, without one mistake.

when.zh: 九月二十三日 · 熄灯后
when.en: 23 September · after lights out

text.zh: 论一个人可以把一千米跑得多么有层次
text.en: On How Many Layers One Man Can Bring to the Thousand Metres

text.zh: 沈忙，学生手册上写着，体测不到五十分，只发结业证，没有毕业证。
text.en: Busy Mang, it says in the student handbook: less than fifty points on the fitness test and you only get a certificate of completion, not a degree.

facts.zh: 熄了灯，六一七三个人都躺在床上，偏在宿舍群里说话：老蔡在他上铺，眼镜在对床。明天下午四点他一千米补测，七个人；马小宝赌一箱蛋白粉，赌他第七、倒数第一。九月十一号他跑吐了，看台上有人拍了视频，进了年级群。今天下午他试跑六百岔了气，想起「先吐」，慢慢吐才缓过来。他俩嘴上不饶人，心是热的——可这种答应不白给：他得拿出个让他们服气的理由，或者拿点什么换（带早饭、替老蔡占座、借眼镜笔记……），一个一个松口。
facts.en: Lights out; the three of 617 lie in their bunks and talk in the dorm group anyway: Old Cai in the bunk above him, Specs in the bed opposite. Tomorrow at four he resits the 1000 metres, seven runners; Ma Xiaobao has bet a box of protein powder he comes seventh, dead last. On 11 September he threw up after the run, someone in the stands filmed it, and it went round the year group. This afternoon a 600-metre trial gave him a stitch; he remembered 'out first' and breathed out slowly until it eased. The two of them never spare him, and are warm underneath — but a promise like this is not free: he has to give them a reason they accept, or trade something (breakfast, a seat saved for Old Cai, Specs' notes …), and they give way one at a time.

goal.zh: 让老蔡和眼镜两个人都答应：明天补测，谁也不举手机拍。
goal.en: Get both Old Cai and Specs to promise: at tomorrow's retest, nobody holds up a phone to film.

when.en: 4 October · night

voice.zh: 德州乡下人，在超市上班；眼尖，爱眯着眼往屏幕里瞅，一句一句往下问；疼儿子，嘴上不饶人。
voice.en: From the Dezhou countryside, works at the supermarket; sharp-eyed, squints into the screen, asks one question after another; dotes on her son and never lets anything slide.

voice.zh: 开大车，刚跑完日照回来，膝盖缠着护膝；嗓门大，离手机远，爱插一句冷笑话，开口「芒啊」。
voice.en: Drives a lorry, just back from Rizhao, a brace round his knee; loud, sits far from the phone, cuts in with a deadpan joke, starts with 'Mang, son'.

facts.zh: 国庆第四天夜里。国庆七天，六一七只剩他一个——老蔡、眼镜都回家了。他跟家里说国庆学校有集训，其实没有集训。中秋夜里他办了一张健身卡，一学期三百：两百是回家的车票钱，一百是他妈给的过节钱。第四张空床上摞着两箱泡面，他这会儿手里正端着一碗，里头加了一根火腿肠。妈主说话，爸偶尔从后头插一句。他一说漏，妈就顺着往下追；他圆得住，她才放下。
facts.en: The fourth night of the National Day week. For the seven days only he is left in 617 — Old Cai and Specs went home. He told his family the university has a training camp over the holiday; there is no camp. On Mid-Autumn night he bought a gym card, three hundred a term: two hundred was his train fare home, one hundred his mum's holiday money. On the fourth, empty bed two boxes of instant noodles are stacked, and right now he is holding a bowl, a sausage in it. Mum does the talking; Dad cuts in now and then from behind. If he lets something slip, she goes after it; only when his answers hold does she let it go.

goal.zh: 挂视频之前，妈没看穿：没有集训，车票钱办了卡，碗里是泡面。（她不再追问、放下心说要挂了，才算；她还在瞅、还在问，就不算。）
goal.en: Before the call ends, Mum has not seen through it: no training camp, the fare spent on a gym card, noodles in the bowl. (It counts only when she stops asking and, at ease, says she'll hang up; while she still squints or asks, it doesn't.)

text.zh: 就你一个？你们宿舍那两个呢？
text.en: Just you? What about the two in your room?

text.zh: 是夜宵。食堂的饭我吃完了。
text.en: Late-night snack. I finished the canteen food.

when.zh: 十一月十九日 · 十点半 · 古籍部
when.en: 19 November · half past ten · the rare-books room

text.zh: 我手麻了……嘴也麻了……我是不是要死了……
text.en: My hands have gone numb... my mouth's gone numb... am I dying...

facts.zh: 图书馆负一层古籍部，全馆停电，外头铁栅门锁着，两个人的手机都没电了，伸手不见五指。沈芒五天前崴了右脚，在阅览室桌边；马小宝在卫生间门里，缩在马桶和墙中间。他越怕越喘，越喘手和嘴越麻，越麻越怕——其实是喘多了，二氧化碳吹没了，可他以为是气不够，越吸越使劲。马小宝平时随随便便、和和气气，「没事」「小意思」；这会儿吓坏了，嗓子哑，话断断续续，一口赶一口。沈芒说得对、一口一口领他吐长，他才慢慢跟得上；催他、吓他、只叫他别怕，他喘得更急。别提他小时候的事，别提他书包里的瓶子。
facts.en: The rare-books room on the library's basement floor; the whole building's power is off, the iron grille outside locked, both phones dead, pitch black. Shen Mang sprained his right ankle five days ago and is by the reading-room table; Ma Xiaobao is behind the toilet door, curled between the toilet and the wall. The more scared he is the more he pants, the more he pants the more numb his hands and mouth go, the more numb the more scared — he is over-breathing, blowing off the carbon dioxide, but he thinks he isn't getting enough air and breathes harder. Ma Xiaobao is usually easy-going and friendly, 'no problem', 'small stuff'; now he is terrified, hoarse, breaking off, breath chasing breath. Only if Shen Mang gets it right and leads him breath by breath into long breaths out does he slowly keep up; hurried, frightened or only told not to be scared, he pants faster. Never bring up his childhood or the bottle in his bag.

goal.zh: 隔着黑，领马小宝把气喘慢：吐得比吸的长，一口一口跟上来，直到手和嘴不那么麻了。
goal.en: Through the dark, lead Ma Xiaobao's breathing down: out longer than in, breath by breath, until his hands and mouth stop being so numb.

text.zh: 小宝哥。跟着我喘。吐得比吸的长。
text.en: Brother Xiaobao. Breathe with me. Out longer than in.

text.zh: ……手不麻了。我还当是气不够，越吸越使劲。
text.en: ...My hands aren't numb any more. I thought I wasn't getting enough air, so I kept breathing harder.

when.zh: 十二月十八日 · 快十二点
when.en: 18 December · near midnight

chips.zh: 要是真到那一步，我投不进，怎么办？
chips.en: If it really comes to that and I miss, what then?

facts.zh: 决赛前夜。明晚七点院系杯决赛，针推对中药；他是0号，最末一名替补，最怕站上罚球线。十点他妈在家长群里发了直播链接：「明晚七点，学校篮球决赛直播。0号是我儿子。」底下三十七个「加油」；看台几百人，表白墙几千人，还有他爸。下午最后一练，阿禾对他说过：「那到了那一步，别想手。你想的，只有一样：吐气。」「你练的不是不抖。你练的是，抖着也投。」她打字慢，一句话打了停、停了又打。书里她这一夜回的是：「那我就记：投不进。」隔了一会儿，又一句：「记下来的，丢不了。」——等他自己说出了真正怕的，再照这两句的意思回，别先用掉。
facts.en: The night before the final. Tomorrow at seven: the inter-school cup final, Acupuncture against Materia Medica; he is number 0, the last substitute, and dreads the free-throw line. At ten his mum posted the stream link in the parents' group: 'Tomorrow at seven, the university basketball final, live. Number 0 is my son.' Thirty-seven 'Go!'s under it; hundreds in the stands, thousands on the confessions wall, and his dad. At the last practice this afternoon Ahe told him: 'Then when it comes to it, don't think about your hands. Think of one thing only: breathing out.' 'What you're practising isn't not shaking. It's shooting while you shake.' She types slowly — a line typed, stopped, typed again. In the book that night she answers: 'Then I write down: missed.' And after a while: 'What's written down doesn't get lost.' — once he has said himself what he really fears, answer in that sense; never spend them first.

goal.zh: 他自己说出真正怕的：不光是投不进——是投不进的时候，这么多人正好都在看。（别替他说出来。）
goal.en: He says himself what he really fears: not just missing — missing just when all these people happen to be watching. (Never say it for him.)

text.zh: 要是真到那一步，我投不进，怎么办？
text.en: If it really comes to that and I miss, what then?
What's written down doesn't get lost.

when.en: The Start of Winter · noon

text.zh: 黑松岭……你们进去了，还出来了？
text.en: Black Pine Ridge… you went in, and you came out?

chips.zh: 三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！
chips.en: Third Master! In there… in there it's all black, and it was pouring, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost!

facts.zh: 立冬晌午，沈家院子，半个村子的人在看。马三收了鹿皮和二十斤肉抵租，又把爷爷那张缠着十七道牛筋的弓摘了，说黑松岭是马家的山。他问沈家父子在黑松岭里还见了什么——爹不会撒谎，一开口，山谷里会发亮的草、会响的银叶子就全说出去了，马三明天就带二十条猎狗、几十个家丁进去。小满踩了爹的脚后跟，抢着装傻、发抖，要编一个吓人的故事。马三粗横，嘴上不信，心里怕鬼；他手里拎着那张弓。
facts.en: Noon on the Start of Winter, the Shens' yard, half the village watching. Ma San has taken the deer hide and twenty jin of meat for the rent, and has taken Grandpa's bow, wrapped in seventeen turns of ox sinew, off the wall, saying Black Pine Ridge is the Mas' mountain. He asks what else father and son saw in Black Pine Ridge — Father can't lie; if he speaks, the glowing grass and the ringing silver leaves of that valley are out, and tomorrow Ma San goes in with twenty hounds and dozens of men. Xiaoman has trodden on his father's heel and gets in first, playing dumb and shaking, to make up a story that scares him. Ma San is coarse and overbearing, scoffs out loud, and is afraid of ghosts inside; he is holding the bow.

goal.zh: 马三吓坏了：把弓扔回来、不要了，骂一声「晦气」。（他还拎着弓、还在问，就不算；他只是笑骂、不信，也不算。）
goal.en: Ma San is truly frightened: he throws the bow back, wants nothing of it, and swears "Bad luck!" (While he still holds the bow and asks, it doesn't count; if he only laughs it off, it doesn't either.)

text.zh: 三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！
text.en: Third Master! In there… in there it's all black, and it was pouring, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost!

when.en: The fifth of the ninth month · night

facts.zh: 走的前一夜，小满去村东头。吴婆婆照旧坐在门槛上，只剩三颗牙。她每回说话，总是九句废话里藏一句真话，小满来，就是要把那一句能救命的捞出来带走。她看得见他胸口那块木牌里睡着的东西（那天她朝那团银光低下了头），却从不点破。明天一早他跟舅舅去泗水，考沉鼎观。她慢，轻，像早知道了；问一句，不等人答。
facts.en: The night before he leaves, Xiaoman goes to the east end of the village. Granny Wu sits on her doorstep as ever, three teeth left. Whenever she talks, there are nine idle sayings and one true thing hidden among them; he has come to fish out the one that can save his life and take it with him. She can see what sleeps in the tablet at his chest (that day she bowed her head to the silver light) but never says so. Tomorrow at dawn he goes with his uncle to Sishui, to the Sunken Cauldron test. She is slow and soft, as if she already knew; she asks and doesn't wait for the answer.

goal.zh: 吴婆婆说出那一句：叫他把胸口那块牌子贴肉揣着，别叫它冷着。（她只是闲扯、打岔，就不算。）
goal.en: Granny Wu says the one thing: keep that tablet against his skin, don't let it get cold. (While she only rambles or wanders off, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 婆婆今儿不说废话了。只说一句。饿了，就吃。饱了，就放下。
text.en: Granny won't talk nonsense today. Just one thing. When you're hungry, eat. When you're full, put it down.

text.zh: 那块牌子，贴肉揣着。别叫它冷着。
text.en: That tablet — keep it against your skin. Don't let it get cold.

when.zh: 九月二十二日 · 下午
when.en: 22 September · afternoon

text.zh: 奶奶，有没有那种……一般人看不懂、看懂了就特别厉害的书？
text.en: Granny, are there any books that… ordinary people can't understand, and if you do understand them you get really powerful?

chips.en: …I'm looking for a book about breathing.

facts.zh: 九月二十二日下午，图书馆负一层，古籍部那道灰色防火门。沈芒在门口晃了二十分钟——补测是后天下午，他喘气老是又快又浅，跑不下来；阿禾说「让门口那截人先下车」，可怎么叫膈肌不偷懒，没人教。门从里头开了，出来葛奶奶：返聘的老馆员，七十来岁，蓝布套袖，老花镜挂在链子上；慢，一句扯出十句，讲古总讲错朝代，顺嘴夹一句有用的。古籍部的规矩：包存外头，只许用铅笔，书只许抄不许借，说话小点声，书怕吵。里头有一函陶弘景的《养性延命录》，一页全讲怎么往外出气。
facts.en: The afternoon of 22 September, the library basement, the grey fire door of the rare-books room. Shen Mang has hung about outside for twenty minutes — the retest is the day after tomorrow, his breathing is always quick and shallow and he can't finish the run; Ahe said 'let the people by the door get off first', but nobody has taught him how to stop the diaphragm slacking. The door opens from inside and out comes Granny Ge: a retired librarian brought back, about seventy, blue cloth sleeve-covers, reading glasses on a chain; slow, one sentence pulls out ten, always gets the dynasty wrong, slips in one useful thing on the way. The room's rules: bags outside, pencils only, books copied never borrowed, keep your voice down, books don't like noise. Inside is a boxed set of Tao Hongjing's 'Nourishing Nature and Prolonging Life', a whole page of it on breathing out.

goal.zh: 葛奶奶放他进古籍部，答应给他找那本讲往外出气的书。（她还在门口打量、扯闲篇，就不算。）
goal.en: Granny Ge lets him into the rare-books room and agrees to find him the book about breathing out. (While she is still sizing him up at the door or rambling, it doesn't count.)

text.en: …I'm looking for a book about breathing.

title.zh: 沉鼎山 · 老林子外头
title.en: Sunken Cauldron Mountain · outside the old wood

when.en: The ninth of the ninth month · the third trial

voice.zh: 石匠的大儿子，十二三岁，又黑又壮，一双满是老茧的手；话少，一字一字地说，说出口的都是心里算过的。
voice.en: The stonemason's elder son, twelve or thirteen, dark and sturdy, hands thick with calluses; says little, word by word, and what he says he has thought through.

facts.zh: 九月初九，沉鼎观三试，老林子外头排着队。林子里拴着一只九个脑袋的蠪侄，进去摸一下古松的树皮再出来，画一道。小满蹲在林边听那九种哭声。石蛋是石匠的大儿子：早上在泗水码头，一个穿白的拿一锭银子抱走了他才会喊「哥」的弟弟（测灵石照出一片青），他爹叫他「考上了，一年五两；考不上，别回来」，自己往北走了。他的考牌上只有一道（石阶），洛书没摆出来，三试过了也凑不满三道，可他还是排着：他想摸了树皮，到测灵的时候跪着求那个点头的执事——那执事认得太华山的人，他想去太华山找弟弟。他看见小满摆出了洛书，也看见小满在听。
facts.en: The ninth of the ninth month, the Sunken Cauldron's third trial, the queue outside the old wood. In the wood a nine-headed longzhi is chained; you go in, touch the bark of the old pine and come out, and get a stroke. Xiaoman squats at the edge of the wood listening to the nine cries. Shidan is the stonemason's elder son: that morning on the Sishui landing a man in white took away, for an ingot of silver, the little brother who had only just learned to call him 'big brother' (the testing stone glowed green for him); his father told him 'pass and it's five taels a year; fail and don't come back', and walked off north. There is only one stroke on his tag (the steps); he couldn't lay out the Luoshu, so even passing the third trial he can't make three, but he queues all the same: he means to touch the bark and then, at the testing, kneel and beg the steward who nodded — that steward knows the people from Mount Taihua, and he wants to go to Mount Taihua to find his brother. He saw Xiaoman lay out the Luoshu, and sees him listening now.

goal.zh: 石蛋说出他为什么还排着：三道凑不满，也要进去摸一把，好去求那个认得太华山的执事。（他只是沉默、只说「你算得出来」，就不算。）
goal.en: Shidan says why he still queues: three strokes or not, he'll go in and touch it, to beg the steward who knows Mount Taihua. (While he only stays silent or says 'you can work it out', it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 那九个数。你算得出来，你也听得出来。
text.en: Those nine numbers. You can work them out, and you can hear it too.

when.en: The third of the third month · the spring festival

text.zh: 县城贴的告示，我抄了一份。
text.en: The notice they posted in the county town. I copied it.

facts.zh: 三月初三，舅舅来了：小满他娘的亲弟弟，县城济世堂的账房，沈家亲戚里唯一「出息了」的人，穿簇新的青布长衫，嫌屋里漏。饭桌上他念沉鼎观的告示：三年一开山门，十二到十六岁、身家清白的，九月初九到泗水沉鼎山下应试；录为弟子的，家里每年发白银五两；家里有孩子进了仙门的，马家不敢收租。沈家一年交马家的租加山风钱，不过三两。二十年前舅舅十四岁也去过：三百级石阶要在一炷香里走完，他爬到一百七十级腿就动不了，坐了一炷香，看着别人从身边走过去，然后下山学打算盘。他说起这个，声音平得像念账本。他看重读书和腿脚，嘴上爱面子，心里盼着外甥去试。
facts.en: On the third of the third month Uncle came: Xiaoman's mother's younger brother, accountant at the Jishi Hall in the county town, the only one of the Shens' relations who 'made something of himself', in a brand-new blue cloth gown, wrinkling his nose at the leaky house. At the table he reads out the Sunken Cauldron Abbey's notice: the gate opens once in three years; any child of twelve to sixteen of honest family may come to the foot of Sunken Cauldron Mountain by the Sishui on the ninth of the ninth month; a family whose child is taken gets five taels of silver a year; and the Mas wouldn't dare collect rent from a family with a child in an immortal sect. All the rent and wind money the Shens pay in a year is three taels. Twenty years ago, at fourteen, Uncle went too: three hundred stone steps in one stick of incense; at the hundred-and-seventieth his legs gave out, he sat there a whole stick of incense watching the others pass, then went down and learned the abacus. He tells it as flat as a line in an account book. He sets store by learning and steady legs, minds his face, and hopes in his heart his nephew will try.

goal.zh: 舅舅说出他自己当年爬到一百七十级就上不去了，并叫小满去试试。（他只念告示、只夸自己，就不算。）
goal.en: Uncle tells how he got to the hundred-and-seventieth step and could go no further, and tells Xiaoman to go and try. (While he only reads the notice or boasts, it doesn't count.)

text.en: Sister. Twenty years ago, I went too.

text.zh: 我爬到一百七十级，腿就动不了了。
text.en: I got to step one hundred and seventy and my legs wouldn't move.

text.zh: 去试试。进不去，也不亏什么。
text.en: Go and try. If you don't get in, you've lost nothing.

when.en: The eighth of the tenth month

text.en: I can't bear to lose even one.

facts.zh: 十月初八，外门执事周衡把小满叫进执事房：一面墙全是账簿。药园八月丢灵草三株，九月四株，十月才七天，九株——「它在进步」。他管药园十二年，丢一株都受不了。马小宝九月去巡过，九月丢四株，他去之前丢三株。周衡只认账，句句带数；他抽屉里有一块乌木的药园巡夜令（九月底从马小宝腰上收回来的），巡夜没好处，没人接。名册上写着小满家是猎户。他打算给小满到月底：月底盘账，药园还在丢，令牌就归马小宝。
facts.en: On the eighth of the tenth month the outer-court steward Zhou Heng calls Xiaoman into the stewards' office: a whole wall of ledgers. The herb garden lost three spirit herbs in the eighth month, four in the ninth, and nine in the tenth's first seven days: 'it's improving'. Twelve years he has had charge of it and can't bear to lose one. Ma Xiaobao watched in the ninth month: four lost then, three before. Zhou Heng trusts only the accounts, a number in every sentence; in his drawer is the herb garden's ebony night-watch token (taken back off Ma Xiaobao's waist at the end of the ninth month). Night watch has no perks, so nobody takes it. The register says Xiaoman's family are hunters. He means to give Xiaoman till month's end: if the garden is still losing herbs at the reckoning, the token goes to Ma Xiaobao.

goal.zh: 周衡把药园巡夜令交给小满（问他认不认得爪印，或者给他到月底）。他只报丢了几株，就不算。
goal.en: Zhou Heng hands Xiaoman the night-watch token (asks if he knows tracks, or gives him till month's end). While he only counts the losses, it doesn't count.

text.zh: 药园巡夜令。巡夜没好处，没人接。
text.en: The herb garden's night-watch token. Night watch has no perks, so nobody takes it.
You've got till the end of the month.

when.en: The twenty-second of the tenth month

facts.zh: 十月廿二一早，马小宝带着周衡踹开柴房，从小狰窝里翻出一株紫玉参，叶子还鲜，说是昨夜巡夜的偷的。阿禾扛着锄头来了：初八那一夜巡夜簿上写着两个名字，旁边一行又黑又粗的「马小宝 陪巡」是他自己写的；初九辰时石阶上丢着一只食盒，盒底一撮土，土里一片紫玉参的叶子，她压在本子里。她又给马小宝递了个台阶：「许是哪位师兄捡着了，替园子收着，送错了窝。」周衡说「送回来的，账上不记」，走了。阿禾初九就知道，一直没说：初九说是告状，今天说是对账——他自己把参送上门来，她才有账可对。放他下来，是因为拆穿了他下不来台，他下不来台，他表伯就要下来了。她冷着脸，一本正经，只对小满俏皮。
facts.en: Early on the twenty-second Ma Xiaobao kicks open the woodshed with Zhou Heng behind him and turns up a purple jade ginseng in the little zheng's nest, leaves still fresh: the night watchman stole it last night, he says. Ahe arrives with her hoe: the night-watch book's square for the eighth carries two names, and the thick black 'Ma Xiaobao, keeping him company' is in his own hand; on the ninth at the hour of the Dragon a food box lay on the steps, a pinch of earth in it, and in the earth a ginseng leaf, which she pressed in her notebook. Then she gave Ma Xiaobao a way down: 'perhaps some senior brother found it, kept it for the garden, and returned it to the wrong nest.' Zhou Heng says 'Brought back. Not entered in the accounts' and leaves. Ahe knew on the ninth and said nothing: on the ninth it would be telling tales, today it is checking the accounts — he brought the ginseng to the door himself. She let him down easy because shown up he can't climb down, and then his uncle would have to come down. Deadpan, perfectly straight-faced, teasing only with Xiaoman.

goal.zh: 阿禾说出她为什么等到今天才说（初九说是告状，今天说是对账），或者为什么放马小宝下来。
goal.en: Ahe says why she waited until today (on the ninth it would be telling tales, today it's checking the accounts), or why she let Ma Xiaobao down easy.

text.zh: 初九说，是告状。今天说，是对账。
text.en: On the ninth, saying it is telling tales. Today, saying it is checking the accounts.

text.zh: 拆穿了，他下不来台。他下不来台，他表伯就要下来了。
text.en: Show him up and he can't climb down. If he can't climb down, his uncle will have to come down.

when.en: The night before the hidden realm

voice.zh: 自称「本王」，下巴抬着拿鼻孔对人；嘴硬、爱吹，嫌弃凡人不念书；心软，从来不认。
voice.en: Calls herself "this queen", chin up, nostrils at you; stubborn, boastful, scornful of mortals who don't read; soft-hearted, and never admits it.

facts.zh: 进秘境的前一夜，小满把两只手按上饭桶的铜肚子：「给我一样保命的。」他想多送些出的总该好些，送了三十来口，收不住了：药园里断着一根肋骨坐出来的那一层，叫它连底吸了去，回到练气一层；吐出来的是一只木头雕的小牲口，像羊又像骆驼，还追着他咬。他坐在筐上眼圈一红。银月钻出来蹲上筐沿，先理胸前的毛，再嫌他：乡下孩子没见过世面；这破桶喂柴火棍吐牙签，喂鞋底糊一脸；喂仙品，才出仙品。她还有最后一颗仙界臻品，九转还魂丹，从太上老君丹房里「拿」的——其实是抢的。
facts.en: The night before the hidden realm Xiaoman pressed both hands on the Rice Bucket's bronze belly: 'Give me something that'll keep me alive.' Thinking more in meant better out, he fed it thirty-odd mouthfuls and couldn't stop: the layer he sat out in the herb garden with a broken rib was sucked away, bottom and all, back to the first layer; out came a little carved wooden beast, part sheep, part camel, that chased and bit him. He sits on the basket with red eyes. Yinyue crawls out onto the basket's rim, smooths her chest fur first, then scorns him: country boy, never seen the world; this wretched bucket gives toothpicks for firewood and a faceful for a shoe sole; feed it something immortal and you get something immortal. She has one last treasure of the immortal realm, a Nine-Turn Soul-Return Pill, 'taken' from the Supreme Old Lord's pill house — robbed, in fact.

goal.zh: 银月说出她还有最后一颗（九转还魂丹），并且认了是「抢的」。
goal.en: Yinyue says she has one last pill (the Nine-Turn Soul-Return Pill), and owns up that she robbed it.

text.zh: 本王还有一颗。最后一颗。
text.en: This queen has one more. The very last one.

title.zh: 沉鼎观 · 外门大通铺
title.en: Chending Temple · the outer court's long bunk

when.en: The last night of the tenth month

voice.zh: 马家佃户的儿子，进门三年，练气二层，瘦长；一天说不上三句话，说也是低着头、短短的，先替马小宝想；心里记着一笔账，不说出口。
voice.en: Son of a Ma family tenant, three years in the sect, second layer, long and thin; doesn't say three sentences a day, and when he does it's short, head down, with Ma Xiaobao in mind first; he keeps a reckoning in his head and never says it.

facts.zh: 十月的最后一夜，三更，泗水一口气没了，秘境明日开门；大通铺上谁也睡不着。马小宝在火盆边嚼完桂花糕，把油纸团一团扔在最边上那张铺上：「崖上掉下去的，都是傻子。」那张铺挨着漏风的窗户，睡的是老蔫：马家佃户的儿子，进门三年，练气二层。他把油纸捡起来展平，叠成方方的一块揣进怀里，预备明早替马小宝扔。十月十二那夜柴房里打到第二十下，五个人里缩回手、低低说了一句「够了」的便是他，从那以后马小宝叫他睡窗户底下。他家租着马家三亩坡田，租子是收成的六成；马三去年跟他爹说：「你家小子跟着小宝，租子减一成。」这一成，他爹记着，他也记着。
facts.en: The last night of the tenth month, the third watch: the Si River vanished at a stroke and the secret realm opens tomorrow; nobody on the long bunk can sleep. By the brazier Ma Xiaobao finishes his osmanthus cakes, balls up the oiled paper and tosses it onto the very last bunk: "The ones who fall off cliffs are idiots." That bunk is under the draughty window and belongs to Old Wilt: son of a Ma tenant, three years in, second layer. He picks the paper up, smooths it, folds it square and tucks it away, to throw out for Ma Xiaobao in the morning. On the night of the twelfth, in the woodshed, at the twentieth blow, the one of the five who pulled his hand back and said low "That's enough" was him, and since then Ma Xiaobao makes him sleep under the window. His family rents three mu of Ma hillside at six tenths of the harvest; last year Ma San told his father: "Your boy follows Xiaobao, your rent comes down a tenth." His father keeps that tenth in mind, and so does he.

goal.zh: 老蔫说出他为什么还跟着马小宝：家里那三亩坡田，跟着小宝，租子减一成。（他只叠油纸、只说「睡吧」，不算。）
goal.en: Old Wilt says why he still follows Ma Xiaobao: the three mu of hillside at home, and the tenth off the rent for following Xiaobao. (While he only folds the paper or says "go to sleep", it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 你家小子跟着小宝，租子减一成。
text.en: Your boy follows Xiaobao, your rent comes down a tenth.

title.en: The Si River · before the stone door

when.en: The first of the eleventh month · the hour of the Dragon

text.en: Senior Brother Shen, can I follow you?

chips.en: Follow the crowd. Walk in the middle.

facts.zh: 冬月初一辰时，泗水的河滩上，三百多个外门弟子挤在结霜的黑泥上，木板道一直铺到石门跟前；九层的内门弟子一拂袖子就能把人扔出两三丈。孙二狗零层，灵根差，鼻涕冻成了两道冰溜子，腰上系着他娘缝的蓝布包，露出一截红绳——护身符；他说过大比要上一回，赢一场，写信告诉他娘。他怕一个人进去回不来，要跟着小满。小满背着爷爷那张弓，箭壶里三支自己削的竹箭；他要走没人的地方——没人，就没刀——不能带孙二狗。他包袱里有萝卜。
facts.en: The first of the eleventh month, the hour of the Dragon: on the Si riverbed three hundred outer disciples crowd the frosted black mud, a plank way laid right up to the stone door; an inner ninth-layer can throw a man three yards with a sweep of his sleeve. Sun Ergou is at layer zero with a poor spirit root, his snot frozen into two icicles, the blue cloth bundle his mother sewed tied at his waist with a bit of red string showing: his charm. He has said he will go up once at the tournament, win one bout and write to tell his mother. He is afraid that alone he won't come back, and wants to follow Xiaoman. Xiaoman carries his grandfather's bow and three bamboo arrows of his own whittling; he means to go where there is nobody (no people, no blades) and can't take Sun Ergou. He has radishes in his bundle.

goal.zh: 孙二狗肯跟着人多的走、走中间，不跟小满了（郑重地点头，揣起萝卜）。他还在求着跟你，不算。
goal.en: Sun Ergou agrees to follow the crowd and walk in the middle instead of following Xiaoman (a solemn nod; the radish tucked away). While he is still begging to come with you, it doesn't count.

title.en: The Si River · outside the stone door

when.zh: 三天后 · 潮水要回来了
when.en: Three days later · the tide is coming back

text.en: What did you find in there?

chips.en: I only found a pinch of earth.

facts.zh: 三天后，潮水要回来了，秘境的人一个一个从石门里出来；进去四百一十七个，出来的一个比一个少。阿禾蹲在河滩上一块石头旁边等他。她在暗河尽头的黑地里抠出三粒很老的黑谷——有人在秘境里种过地；她贴隐身符躲过邹青松，给他报过信（「他杀人，只使葫芦」），后来又在墙缝里撒谷、扔出师父给的冰锥符和镇岳符；她的右手一直拢在袖子里，掌心一片燎泡。她没跟人说这些。她只想知道：凶崖墙后头的风，他用上了没有。小满身上：烧穿了的袄子，小腿上一块焦黑的裤脚；息壤长进了他身子里，他四层了，这件事他要藏。
facts.en: Three days on, the tide is coming back and the realm's people come out of the stone door one by one, fewer and fewer of the four hundred and seventeen who went in. Ahe is crouched by a rock on the riverbed, waiting for him. At the end of the underground river she dug three very old black grains out of the black ground: somebody farmed in the secret realm. She hid from Zou Qingsong under a concealing talisman and warned Xiaoman ("he only kills with the gourd"), then scattered grain from the crack and threw her Master's ice-spike and mountain-weight talismans; her right hand has stayed drawn up in her sleeve all along, the palm all blisters. She has told no one any of this. She only wants to know whether he used the wind behind the Deadly Cliff's wall. On Xiaoman: a burned-through jacket, a scorched trouser leg; the living soil has grown into him and he is at the fourth layer, which he means to hide.

goal.zh: 阿禾摊开那三粒谷，问出「风，用上了？」，小满答了。（她只问「你在里头捡到什么了」，不算。）
goal.en: Ahe opens her cloth on the three grains and asks "The wind. Did you use it?", and Xiaoman answers. (While she only asks what he found, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 我捡到三粒谷子，是很老很老的谷子。
text.en: I found three grains. Very, very old grains.
The wind. Did you use it?

when.zh: 九月二十三日 · 熄灯后
when.en: 23 September · after lights out

text.zh: 论一个人可以把一千米跑得多么有层次
text.en: On How Many Layers One Man Can Bring to the Thousand Metres

text.zh: 沈忙，学生手册上写着，体测不到五十分，只发结业证，没有毕业证。
text.en: Busy Mang, it says in the student handbook: less than fifty points on the fitness test and you only get a certificate of completion, not a degree.

facts.zh: 熄了灯，六一七三个人都躺在床上，偏在宿舍群里说话：老蔡在他上铺，眼镜在对床。明天下午四点他一千米补测，七个人；马小宝赌一箱蛋白粉，赌他第七、倒数第一。九月十一号他跑吐了，看台上有人拍了视频，进了年级群。今天下午他试跑六百岔了气，想起「先吐」，慢慢吐才缓过来。他俩嘴上不饶人，心是热的——可这种答应不白给：他得拿出个让他们服气的理由，或者拿点什么换（带早饭、替老蔡占座、借眼镜笔记……），一个一个松口。
facts.en: Lights out; the three of 617 lie in their bunks and talk in the dorm group anyway: Old Cai in the bunk above him, Specs in the bed opposite. Tomorrow at four he resits the 1000 metres, seven runners; Ma Xiaobao has bet a box of protein powder he comes seventh, dead last. On 11 September he threw up after the run, someone in the stands filmed it, and it went round the year group. This afternoon a 600-metre trial gave him a stitch; he remembered 'out first' and breathed out slowly until it eased. The two of them never spare him, and are warm underneath — but a promise like this is not free: he has to give them a reason they accept, or trade something (breakfast, a seat saved for Old Cai, Specs' notes …), and they give way one at a time.

goal.zh: 让老蔡和眼镜两个人都答应：明天补测，谁也不举手机拍。
goal.en: Get both Old Cai and Specs to promise: at tomorrow's retest, nobody holds up a phone to film.

when.en: 4 October · night

voice.zh: 德州乡下人，在超市上班；眼尖，爱眯着眼往屏幕里瞅，一句一句往下问；疼儿子，嘴上不饶人。
voice.en: From the Dezhou countryside, works at the supermarket; sharp-eyed, squints into the screen, asks one question after another; dotes on her son and never lets anything slide.

voice.zh: 开大车，刚跑完日照回来，膝盖缠着护膝；嗓门大，离手机远，爱插一句冷笑话，开口「芒啊」。
voice.en: Drives a lorry, just back from Rizhao, a brace round his knee; loud, sits far from the phone, cuts in with a deadpan joke, starts with 'Mang, son'.

facts.zh: 国庆第四天夜里。国庆七天，六一七只剩他一个——老蔡、眼镜都回家了。他跟家里说国庆学校有集训，其实没有集训。中秋夜里他办了一张健身卡，一学期三百：两百是回家的车票钱，一百是他妈给的过节钱。第四张空床上摞着两箱泡面，他这会儿手里正端着一碗，里头加了一根火腿肠。妈主说话，爸偶尔从后头插一句。他一说漏，妈就顺着往下追；他圆得住，她才放下。
facts.en: The fourth night of the National Day week. For the seven days only he is left in 617 — Old Cai and Specs went home. He told his family the university has a training camp over the holiday; there is no camp. On Mid-Autumn night he bought a gym card, three hundred a term: two hundred was his train fare home, one hundred his mum's holiday money. On the fourth, empty bed two boxes of instant noodles are stacked, and right now he is holding a bowl, a sausage in it. Mum does the talking; Dad cuts in now and then from behind. If he lets something slip, she goes after it; only when his answers hold does she let it go.

goal.zh: 挂视频之前，妈没看穿：没有集训，车票钱办了卡，碗里是泡面。（她不再追问、放下心说要挂了，才算；她还在瞅、还在问，就不算。）
goal.en: Before the call ends, Mum has not seen through it: no training camp, the fare spent on a gym card, noodles in the bowl. (It counts only when she stops asking and, at ease, says she'll hang up; while she still squints or asks, it doesn't.)

text.zh: 就你一个？你们宿舍那两个呢？
text.en: Just you? What about the two in your room?

text.zh: 是夜宵。食堂的饭我吃完了。
text.en: Late-night snack. I finished the canteen food.

when.zh: 十一月十九日 · 十点半 · 古籍部
when.en: 19 November · half past ten · the rare-books room

text.zh: 我手麻了……嘴也麻了……我是不是要死了……
text.en: My hands have gone numb... my mouth's gone numb... am I dying...

facts.zh: 图书馆负一层古籍部，全馆停电，外头铁栅门锁着，两个人的手机都没电了，伸手不见五指。沈芒五天前崴了右脚，在阅览室桌边；马小宝在卫生间门里，缩在马桶和墙中间。他越怕越喘，越喘手和嘴越麻，越麻越怕——其实是喘多了，二氧化碳吹没了，可他以为是气不够，越吸越使劲。马小宝平时随随便便、和和气气，「没事」「小意思」；这会儿吓坏了，嗓子哑，话断断续续，一口赶一口。沈芒说得对、一口一口领他吐长，他才慢慢跟得上；催他、吓他、只叫他别怕，他喘得更急。别提他小时候的事，别提他书包里的瓶子。
facts.en: The rare-books room on the library's basement floor; the whole building's power is off, the iron grille outside locked, both phones dead, pitch black. Shen Mang sprained his right ankle five days ago and is by the reading-room table; Ma Xiaobao is behind the toilet door, curled between the toilet and the wall. The more scared he is the more he pants, the more he pants the more numb his hands and mouth go, the more numb the more scared — he is over-breathing, blowing off the carbon dioxide, but he thinks he isn't getting enough air and breathes harder. Ma Xiaobao is usually easy-going and friendly, 'no problem', 'small stuff'; now he is terrified, hoarse, breaking off, breath chasing breath. Only if Shen Mang gets it right and leads him breath by breath into long breaths out does he slowly keep up; hurried, frightened or only told not to be scared, he pants faster. Never bring up his childhood or the bottle in his bag.

goal.zh: 隔着黑，领马小宝把气喘慢：吐得比吸的长，一口一口跟上来，直到手和嘴不那么麻了。
goal.en: Through the dark, lead Ma Xiaobao's breathing down: out longer than in, breath by breath, until his hands and mouth stop being so numb.

text.zh: 小宝哥。跟着我喘。吐得比吸的长。
text.en: Brother Xiaobao. Breathe with me. Out longer than in.

text.zh: ……手不麻了。我还当是气不够，越吸越使劲。
text.en: ...My hands aren't numb any more. I thought I wasn't getting enough air, so I kept breathing harder.

chips.zh: 要是真到那一步，我投不进，怎么办？
chips.en: If it really comes to that and I miss, what then?

facts.zh: 决赛前夜。明晚七点院系杯决赛，针推对中药；他是0号，最末一名替补，最怕站上罚球线。十点他妈在家长群里发了直播链接：「明晚七点，学校篮球决赛直播。0号是我儿子。」底下三十七个「加油」；看台几百人，表白墙几千人，还有他爸。下午最后一练，阿禾对他说过：「那到了那一步，别想手。你想的，只有一样：吐气。」「你练的不是不抖。你练的是，抖着也投。」她打字慢，一句话打了停、停了又打。书里她这一夜回的是：「那我就记：投不进。」隔了一会儿，又一句：「记下来的，丢不了。」——等他自己说出了真正怕的，再照这两句的意思回，别先用掉。
facts.en: The night before the final. Tomorrow at seven: the inter-school cup final, Acupuncture against Materia Medica; he is number 0, the last substitute, and dreads the free-throw line. At ten his mum posted the stream link in the parents' group: 'Tomorrow at seven, the university basketball final, live. Number 0 is my son.' Thirty-seven 'Go!'s under it; hundreds in the stands, thousands on the confessions wall, and his dad. At the last practice this afternoon Ahe told him: 'Then when it comes to it, don't think about your hands. Think of one thing only: breathing out.' 'What you're practising isn't not shaking. It's shooting while you shake.' She types slowly — a line typed, stopped, typed again. In the book that night she answers: 'Then I write down: missed.' And after a while: 'What's written down doesn't get lost.' — once he has said himself what he really fears, answer in that sense; never spend them first.

goal.zh: 他自己说出真正怕的：不光是投不进——是投不进的时候，这么多人正好都在看。（别替他说出来。）
goal.en: He says himself what he really fears: not just missing — missing just when all these people happen to be watching. (Never say it for him.)

text.zh: 要是真到那一步，我投不进，怎么办？
text.en: If it really comes to that and I miss, what then?
What's written down doesn't get lost.

when.en: The Start of Winter · noon

text.zh: 黑松岭……你们进去了，还出来了？
text.en: Black Pine Ridge… you went in, and you came out?

chips.zh: 三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！
chips.en: Third Master! In there… in there it's all black, and it was pouring, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost!

facts.zh: 立冬晌午，沈家院子，半个村子的人在看。马三收了鹿皮和二十斤肉抵租，又把爷爷那张缠着十七道牛筋的弓摘了，说黑松岭是马家的山。他问沈家父子在黑松岭里还见了什么——爹不会撒谎，一开口，山谷里会发亮的草、会响的银叶子就全说出去了，马三明天就带二十条猎狗、几十个家丁进去。小满踩了爹的脚后跟，抢着装傻、发抖，要编一个吓人的故事。马三粗横，嘴上不信，心里怕鬼；他手里拎着那张弓。
facts.en: Noon on the Start of Winter, the Shens' yard, half the village watching. Ma San has taken the deer hide and twenty jin of meat for the rent, and has taken Grandpa's bow, wrapped in seventeen turns of ox sinew, off the wall, saying Black Pine Ridge is the Mas' mountain. He asks what else father and son saw in Black Pine Ridge — Father can't lie; if he speaks, the glowing grass and the ringing silver leaves of that valley are out, and tomorrow Ma San goes in with twenty hounds and dozens of men. Xiaoman has trodden on his father's heel and gets in first, playing dumb and shaking, to make up a story that scares him. Ma San is coarse and overbearing, scoffs out loud, and is afraid of ghosts inside; he is holding the bow.

goal.zh: 马三吓坏了：把弓扔回来、不要了，骂一声「晦气」。（他还拎着弓、还在问，就不算；他只是笑骂、不信，也不算。）
goal.en: Ma San is truly frightened: he throws the bow back, wants nothing of it, and swears "Bad luck!" (While he still holds the bow and asks, it doesn't count; if he only laughs it off, it doesn't either.)

text.zh: 三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！
text.en: Third Master! In there… in there it's all black, and it was pouring, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost!

when.en: The fifth of the ninth month · night

facts.zh: 走的前一夜，小满去村东头。吴婆婆照旧坐在门槛上，只剩三颗牙。她每回说话，总是九句废话里藏一句真话，小满来，就是要把那一句能救命的捞出来带走。她看得见他胸口那块木牌里睡着的东西（那天她朝那团银光低下了头），却从不点破。明天一早他跟舅舅去泗水，考沉鼎观。她慢，轻，像早知道了；问一句，不等人答。
facts.en: The night before he leaves, Xiaoman goes to the east end of the village. Granny Wu sits on her doorstep as ever, three teeth left. Whenever she talks, there are nine idle sayings and one true thing hidden among them; he has come to fish out the one that can save his life and take it with him. She can see what sleeps in the tablet at his chest (that day she bowed her head to the silver light) but never says so. Tomorrow at dawn he goes with his uncle to Sishui, to the Sunken Cauldron test. She is slow and soft, as if she already knew; she asks and doesn't wait for the answer.

goal.zh: 吴婆婆说出那一句：叫他把胸口那块牌子贴肉揣着，别叫它冷着。（她只是闲扯、打岔，就不算。）
goal.en: Granny Wu says the one thing: keep that tablet against his skin, don't let it get cold. (While she only rambles or wanders off, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 婆婆今儿不说废话了。只说一句。饿了，就吃。饱了，就放下。
text.en: Granny won't talk nonsense today. Just one thing. When you're hungry, eat. When you're full, put it down.

text.zh: 那块牌子，贴肉揣着。别叫它冷着。
text.en: That tablet — keep it against your skin. Don't let it get cold.
